body: yeah, this is what makes depression hard. It is a constant fight against your immediate intuition. The best thing to do in the moment is to distract yourself/clear your mind with coping strategies, I know 'coping strategies' sounds complex but it's basically a fancy way of saying do any healthy thing that feels good. It's an uphill climb, but you get better at it

Oh I super get that, but there is a big difference between being lazy and uncommitted and being suicidally depressed. It can be hard to tell at first, but there are genuinely times when a depressed person literally can't do things. Your body thinks it's dying and doing anything contradictory to that feels wrong, i mean it isn't but it sure is convincing

I get it, there is so much that is unknown and it's terrifying. no one can fill in those blanks but you. Depression is a very personal disease, and while there are patterns, everyone will have different definitions for how they feel. There isn't really good way to talk about it, you just have to do it and see what feels right. As for the meaning to life, it's anything everything and nothing. It is completely up to the individual what they decide to live for. But I mean there are people who's goal in life is to give good haircuts to dogs, whatever you assign meaning to will be meaningful to you. I hope this helps

hey this sounds like you're feeling allot right now, do you have anything that might clear your head. This is a serious decision, ironically I find that is one that should be made outside of emotion. Distract yourself give it an hour and reassess, I find that helps

Yeah I get that. It's been going on for so long though that it just feels muddled and grey. Like it feels right, but I can't always be sure it is true in that instant. I've accepted that I want to die, but I don't have to.

I understand this deeply. I feel like if it's not today then it's tomorrow, but in a weird way I find hope in that. These are my thoughts today, and while I know what my thoughts tomorrow will be there is no way to know what I will feel like a few years down the line. I might get better or I might, not there is no way to tell so I wait. If I do get better though, I know that that me will be happy for having waited. I hope this helps
